# hpe_morpheus_cypher (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Cypher secret resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_cypher" "example" {
  id    = "secret/my-api-key"
  value = "sk-abc123def456"
  ttl   = 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The key path for the cypher secret (e.g. secret/mykey).
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The secret value to store.

### Optional

- `ttl` (Number) Time to live in seconds. 0 means no expiry.

### Read-Only

- `lease_duration` (Number) The lease duration in seconds.

## Import

Import is supported using the resource ID.

```bash
terraform import hpe_morpheus_cypher.example 123
```
